title: Canton solvency evidence pack v1
description: The signed index of an evidence pack (SPEC.md §15). Every document in this format verifies on its own, which is not the same as a delivery being complete: a proof says nothing about what else was sent, so a folder with one customer's proof removed verifies exactly as cleanly as the whole one. This index commits to the set, so an omission is a detectable act rather than an unremarkable absence.

report_digest.description: The report this pack is evidence for (SPEC.md §8.2). Bound into the pack digest, so a pack cannot be lifted onto a different report.

entries.description: Sorted by name, so the same files assembled in any order produce the same pack. The count is committed alongside the entries.

name.description: The file name as delivered. Never a path: a pack describes one directory, and a member that could escape it would be a delivery instruction rather than an integrity claim.

signature.description: Detached signature over the pack digest. The embedded key is for display; verification requires a caller-supplied trusted key, ideally taken from an anchor (SPEC.md §8.4).
